data.name: Dolphin Spotting Sail
data.headline: 2 Hour Private Charter
data.description: Set sail along the bay and witness the captivating city skyline, multi-million dollar waterfront mansions, and diverse wildlife. Playful dolphins often make appearances, accompanied by pelicans, and on rare occasions, you might spot manatees. This sail is the perfect opportunity to connect with nature, while enjoying the luxury of a Leopard catamaran.

meeting_point.address: 6800 Sunshine Drive South St. Petersburg, FL US 33705

data.cancellation_notes:
Customer Cancellation: Cancellations must be requested via call or email no less than 24hrs before trip departure for a full refund. No shows will be charged full price. 

Weather Cancellations: If your trip's departure may be impacted by weather, our captains will reach out via text or email no less than 2hrs before departure with a weather update. Should the trip be canceled, guests are entitled to a full refund.
